summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TAMBVRINI luxury fashion ecommerce app. Backend APIs working perfectly (18/18 tests passed). Frontend UI largely functional with critical modal interaction issues blocking cart and menu operations.

ui_bugs.issue: Close button not clickable due to modal overlay interception
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot close cart drawer once opened

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation links not clickable due to modal backdrop overlay
ui_bugs.impact: Users cannot navigate via mobile menu

design_issues.issue: Console warnings about missing DialogTitle and Description for modal components

passed_tests: Homepage loads with all sections (hero, campaign, categories, featured, story, tennis, newsletter)
Header navigation elements present and functional
Shop page loads with products, filters, and sorting
Product detail pages load with images, sizes, colors, add to cart
User registration and login flow works
Product image gallery and thumbnails work
Backend APIs: products, auth, newsletter, checkout, seed (18/18 passed)
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical modal overlay interaction issues preventing users from clicking cart close button and mobile menu navigation links. The modal backdrop is intercepting pointer events with class 'fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/80'. Needs force=true or proper z-index/pointer-events CSS fixes.

success_percentage.frontend: 85% (major functionality works, critical interaction bugs present)
